submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, production character portrait asset sheet. Make 8 distinct Taoist chibi transport company MANAGER bust portraits, on a genuinely transparent background. Style based STRICTLY on attached mail/team images: expressive oversized heads, short compact bodies, refined warm hand-painting, jade, ivory and warm-gold clothes, subtle silk cloth material and jade ties. 4 columns by 2 rows, all 8 portraits within evenly separated equal cells with 12% padding. Desired high native resolution 2048x1024. No frames, circles, labels, letters, numbers, UI or backdrop. No checkerboard. Each portrait is head and shoulders, frontal or slight 3/4, complete hair silhouette and shoulders not cropped, uniform head scale. Diverse ORIGINAL Chinese fantasy business/transport workers, do not make eight versions of same face. Row1 left to right: cheerful young man, short spiky dark hair gold headband jade short robe; capable young woman black braid bun ivory jacket jade collar; friendly older man gray beard and rounded spectacles dark-teal jacket; middle-aged stout smiling woman black updo gold hairpin cream clothes. Row2 left to right: angular middle-aged man straight black hair tied back green jacket; young woman short dark brown hair jade ribbon simple ivory outfit; jovial elderly bald man with side white tufts thin eyebrows jade vest; calm young dark-haired woman with high ponytail green scarf brass fastener. No martial weapons, no crowns or overloaded jewelry, small transport guild seal at collar. Gentle neutral daylight portrait lighting, clear faces, no photorealism or toy plastic. Preserve each identity and silhouette consistently.
